properties.NAME: New Plymouth Colony
properties.CHANGE: [13 January 1629/1630] The Council for New England issued a new land patent (the "Old Charter")  that granted land title and trading rights, but no powers of government, to New Plymouth colony. New Plymouth Colony included part of present Rhode Island.

properties.NAME: Pawtuxet Settlement
properties.CHANGE: In 1642, Massachusetts, responding to a request from disgruntled Rhode Islanders, extended its jurisdiction over the settlement at Pawtuxet.

properties.NAME: SUFFOLK (Mass.)
properties.CHANGE: SUFFOLK (Mass.) created as one of four original counties in Massachusetts. Part of SUFFOLK (Mass.) was in present northeastern Rhode Island.

properties.NAME: Rhode Island Colony
properties.CHANGE: [14 March 1643/1644] Roger Williams secured a Parliamentary patent for Rhode Island (called "Providence Plantations") that granted authority for self-government; western boundary is estimated.

properties.NAME: Rhode Island Colony
properties.CHANGE: The Pawtuxet settlers, who gave their allegiance to Massachusetts in 1642, returned to Rhode Island jurisdiction.

properties.NAME: Connecticut Colony
properties.CHANGE: King Charles II granted Connecticut a charter as a self-governing corporate colony, with an eastern boundary at Narragansett Bay. R.I. did not concede its claim to area between the Pawcatuck R. and Narragansett Bay, but Conn. took control of the area.

properties.NAME: Narragansett Country
properties.CHANGE: King Charles II granted Connecticut a charter as a self-governing corporate colony, with an eastern boundary at Narragansett Bay, overlapping part of the R.I. patent. R.I. did not concede its claim to the territory, but Conn. took control of the area.

properties.NAME: Rhode Island Colony
properties.CHANGE: King Charles II granted Rhode Island a charter as a self-governing corporate colony. The charter's boundary descriptions included Narragansett Country, and also resulted in gains from New Plymouth (in Narragansett Bay), and from SUFFOLK (Mass.).

properties.NAME: New Plymouth Colony
properties.CHANGE: New Plymouth Colony lost to Rhode Island when King Charles II granted Rhode Island a charter as a self-governing corporate colony.

properties.NAME: Rhode Island Colony
properties.CHANGE: [May 1664] Rhode Island lost the northeast corner of the present state to New Plymouth when a joint commission from Massachusetts and Plymouth demarcated their mutual boundary ("Old Colony Line").

properties.NAME: New Plymouth Colony
properties.CHANGE: [May 1664] New Plymouth Colony gained from SUFFOLK (Mass.) and Rhode Island Colony when a joint commission from Massachusetts and Plymouth demarcated their mutual boundary ("Old Colony Line").

properties.NAME: Rhode Island Colony
properties.CHANGE: Royal commissioners decided dispute over the Narragansett Country by placing it directly under royal jurisdiction. Named King's Province; R.I. given temp. authority pending royal decision. King's Province treated here as separate from Rhode Island.

properties.NAME: King's Province
properties.CHANGE: King's Province established by royal commissioners who decided dispute over the Narragansett Country by dismissing Mass. claim, putting Conn. claim in abeyance, and placing area under royal jurisdiction. R. I. given temp. authority over Kings Province.

properties.NAME: SUFFOLK (Mass.)
properties.CHANGE: [27 February 1664/1665] SUFFOLK (Mass.) gained from Rhode Island Colony when royal commissioners set the provincial boundaries of Mass., New Plymouth, and R.I. along Blackstone River and east side of Narragansett Bay, pending a conclusive royal decision.

properties.NAME: Rhode Island Colony
properties.CHANGE: [27 February 1664/1665] Rhode Island Colony lost to SUFFOLK (Mass.) and to New Plymouth Colony when royal boundary commissioners set eastern boundary of R.I. along Blackstone River and east side of Narragansett Bay, pending a conclusive royal decision.

properties.NAME: New Plymouth Colony
properties.CHANGE: [27 February 1664/1665] New Plymouth gained from Rhode Island Colony when royal boundary  commissioners set Rhode Island's eastern limit along the Blackstone River and east coast of Narragansett Bay, pending a conclusive royal decision.

properties.NAME: BRISTOL (Mass.)
properties.CHANGE: BRISTOL (Mass.) created as one of three original counties in New Plymouth Colony.

properties.NAME: SUFFOLK (Mass.)
properties.CHANGE: [15 March 1689/1690] SUFFOLK (Mass.) gained from Connecticut when Massachusetts created the town of Woodstock within present Connecticut; area within present Rhode Island was unchanged.

properties.NAME: RHODE ISLAND
properties.CHANGE: RHODE ISLAND County (now NEWPORT) created as one of two original counties, consisting of Block Island and the islands in Narragansett Bay.

properties.NAME: PROVIDENCE PL.
properties.CHANGE: PROVIDENCE PLANTATIONS (now PROVIDENCE) created as one of two original counties, consisting of the mainland part of Rhode Island.

properties.NAME: Rhode Island Colony
properties.CHANGE: Rhode Island and Conn. agreed on their mutual boundary substantially along the line established by colonial agents in 1662, described in R.I.'s 1663 charter and claimed since then by Rhode Island. This boundary became effective almost immediately.

properties.NAME: KINGS
properties.CHANGE: KINGS (now WASHINGTON) created from PROVIDENCE.

properties.NAME: PROVIDENCE
properties.CHANGE: PROVIDENCE PLANTATIONS renamed PROVIDENCE; lost to creation of KINGS (now WASHINGTON).

properties.NAME: NEWPORT
properties.CHANGE: RHODE ISLAND renamed NEWPORT.

properties.NAME: SUFFOLK (Mass.)
properties.CHANGE: SUFFOLK (Mass.) lost to creation of WORCESTER (Mass.). Area within present Rhode Island was unchanged.

properties.NAME: BRISTOL
properties.CHANGE: [17 February 1746/1747] BRISTOL created from BRISTOL (Mass.) when Rhode Island implemented the 1746 royal settlement of the boundary with Massachusetts.

properties.NAME: NEWPORT
properties.CHANGE: [17 February 1746/1747] NEWPORT gained from BRISTOL (Mass.) when Rhode Island implemented the 1746 royal settlement of the boundary with Massachusetts. NEWPORT included part of present Massachusetts.

properties.NAME: PROVIDENCE
properties.CHANGE: [17 February 1746/1747] PROVIDENCE gained from BRISTOL (Mass.) and SUFFOLK (Mass.) when Rhode Island implemented the 1746 royal settlement of the boundary with Massachusetts.

properties.NAME: BRISTOL (Mass.)
properties.CHANGE: [17 February 1746/1747] BRISTOL (Mass.) lost to NEWPORT and PROVIDENCE, and lost to creation of BRISTOL when Rhode Island implemented the 1746 royal settlement of the boundary with Massachusetts. BRISTOL (Mass.) included part of present Rhode Island.

properties.NAME: KENT
properties.CHANGE: KENT created from PROVIDENCE.

properties.NAME: PROVIDENCE
properties.CHANGE: PROVIDENCE lost to creation of KENT.

properties.NAME: WASHINGTON
properties.CHANGE: KINGS renamed WASHINGTON.

properties.NAME: PROVIDENCE
properties.CHANGE: PROVIDENCE gained from BRISTOL (Mass.) when Massachusetts and Rhode Island implemented the U.S. Supreme Court settlement (31 Dec 1861) of their boundary to the Atlantic Ocean.
properties.CITATION: (Bayles, Providence, 1:29; R.I. Acts and Resolves, 1861, ch. 379, sec. 2/p. 4; Ullman, 83-84; Van Zandt, 68)

properties.NAME: NEWPORT
properties.CHANGE: NEWPORT lost to BRISTOL (Mass.) when Massachusetts and Rhode Island implemented the U.S. Supreme Court settlement (31 Dec 1861) of their boundary to the Atlantic Ocean.
properties.CITATION: (Bayles, Providence, 1:29; R.I. Acts and Resolves, 1861, ch. 379, sec. 2/p. 4; Ullman, 83-84; Van Zandt, 68)

properties.NAME: WASHINGTON
properties.CHANGE: WASHINGTON gained Block Island from NEWPORT.

properties.NAME: NEWPORT
properties.CHANGE: NEWPORT lost Block Island to WASHINGTON.
